summary.text: Career is supported by five of the seven families with none against: the lord vote rests on Venus, the exalted lord of the 6th, and Mercury, lord of the 2nd, placed in the 10th, the Sun and Mercury form a Kendra-Trikona Raja yoga in the 10th, and the house vote stays for career although the 10th itself has the lowest Bhava Bala of its houses at 4.51 rupas, its lord Saturn standing at a Shadbala ratio of 0.69 [vote:career.lord] [rule:yoga.kendra_trikona_raja] [vote:career.house]. For a change of job, the career window the engine scores highest is 2029-10-23 to 2032-06-23, the Jupiter–Venus sub-period, whose lord Venus is exalted and rules the 6th, though in its strongest stretch, 2030-05-01 to 2030-09-22, Saturn transits the 8th and Jupiter the 1st from the Moon, both graded adverse [fact:timing.career.windows.0] [fact:timing.career.windows.1.score] [fact:timing.career.windows.2.score] [fact:vimshottari.periods.Jupiter-Venus] [fact:planets.Venus.dignity] [fact:lordship.Venus] [fact:transits.rows.92] [fact:transits.rows.93]. The nearer windows, 2026-10-21 to 2027-01-24 and 2027-10-20 to 2028-02-23, fall in the Jupiter–Mercury sub-period with Saturn in the 6th from the Moon graded favourable, and the engine marks 2028-11-17 to 2029-08-08, in the Jupiter–Ketu sub-period, as the span to avoid [fact:timing.career.windows.2] [fact:timing.career.windows.1] [fact:transits.rows.0] [fact:transits.rows.30] [fact:timing.career.avoid].
summary.timing_line: Best window for career by the engine's timing score: 2029-10-23 to 2032-06-23 (Vimshottari Jupiter–Venus, score 0.84), strongest from 2030-05-01 to 2030-09-22 (score 0.89). Window to avoid: 2028-11-17 to 2029-08-08 (Vimshottari Jupiter–Ketu, score 0.47).
summary.timing_note: These are periods the engine scores as favourable for career; it does not predict when you will act.
